LanguageData.LP_UnfinishedFleshArt.label: unfinished flesh artwork
LanguageData.LP_UnfinishedFleshArt.description: A lump of raw meat being shaped; the bone shards are in place, the sinew not yet fully wound.
LanguageData.LP_UnfinishedLeatherCarving.label: unfinished leather carving
LanguageData.LP_UnfinishedLeatherCarving.description: A half-carved, half-stitched piece of leather.
LanguageData.LP_LeatherCarvingSmall.label: small leather carving
LanguageData.LP_LeatherCarvingSmall.description: A torso-sized piece of cloth or leather carved, embossed and stitched into art. Lighter than stone or wood sculptures, and more vulnerable to fire.
LanguageData.LP_LeatherCarvingLarge.label: large leather carving
LanguageData.LP_LeatherCarvingLarge.description: A man-high leather work: hide stretched and stitched over a frame, its surface covered in carved patterns. Lighter than stone or wood sculptures, and more vulnerable to fire.
LanguageData.LP_LeatherCarvingGrand.label: grand leather carving
LanguageData.LP_LeatherCarvingGrand.description: A huge work stitched together from dozens of hides, big enough to fill a room. Lighter than stone or wood sculptures, and more vulnerable to fire.
LanguageData.LP_FleshArtSmall.label: small flesh artwork
LanguageData.LP_FleshArtSmall.description: A torso-sized work shaped from raw meat, sinew and bone shards, set with salt and wax so it never rots. Viewers often can't tell whether they are moved or offended.
LanguageData.LP_FleshArtLarge.label: large flesh artwork
LanguageData.LP_FleshArtLarge.description: A man-high flesh work: muscle bundles wound around a skeleton, set with salt and wax so it never rots. Viewers often can't tell whether they are moved or offended.
LanguageData.LP_FleshArtGrand.label: grand flesh artwork
LanguageData.LP_FleshArtGrand.description: A huge work piled from heaps of raw meat and whole skeletons, big enough to fill a room, set with salt and wax so it never rots. Viewers often can't tell whether they are moved or offended.
